pricing.accountNote: Buying a plan needs a free account. If you have been practising as a guest, your history comes with you.

smallPrint.heading: How billing works
smallPrint.currency: Prices are in euros and include VAT.
smallPrint.renewal: Plans renew every month until you cancel. Cancel any time from your account; the plan stays on until the end of the month you paid for.
smallPrint.withdrawal: Access starts as soon as you pay. At checkout you are asked to confirm that you want it straight away and that the 14-day right of withdrawal ends when it starts.
smallPrint.cards: Card details are entered in fields provided by Stripe, our payment provider, and go straight to Stripe. They never reach our servers.

checkout.title: Choose your plan and pay
checkout.lead: Monthly, VAT included, cancel any time from your account.

unavailable.title: Payments are not available right now
unavailable.body: Nothing can be bought on this site at the moment, so nothing will be charged. Everything that is open stays open.

allAccess.title: You already have All access
allAccess.body: Every exam and the AI tutor are already open to you, so there is nothing more to buy.

success.title: Your plan is active
success.leadExam: {plan} for {exam} is open to you now.
success.renews: It renews on {date} and every month after that, until you cancel.
success.receipt: Stripe, our payment provider, sends a receipt to {email}.

processing.title: Your payment is being processed
processing.body: Your bank has not confirmed the payment yet. Your plan starts as soon as it does; refresh this page in a minute.

pending.title: Waiting for your payment
pending.body: We have not received confirmation of this payment yet. If you have just paid, refresh this page in a moment. If you left the payment unfinished, you can try again; nothing has been charged.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.body: Your bank declined the payment or the verification was not completed. Nothing was charged. You can try again with the same or another card.

expired.title: This checkout has expired
expired.body: The payment was not completed in time, so nothing was charged. Start a new checkout whenever you are ready.

missing.title: We could not find that checkout
missing.body: It may belong to a different account. Your plans are listed on your account page.

form.examRequired: Choose the exam this plan is for.
form.examHint: A single-exam plan covers one exam. You can hold several, one for each exam you are preparing for.
form.countryHint: Used to apply the right VAT. The price you pay does not change.
form.testMode: Test mode: use card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any CVC. For 3-D Secure, use 4000 0027 6000 3184.
form.secure: Card details are entered in secure fields provided by Stripe and go straight to Stripe; they never reach our servers.
form.consent: I want my plan to start now. I understand that I lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once access starts.
form.consentRequired: Please tick this box to continue.
form.errorTitle: The payment did not go through
form.networkError: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was charged.
form.genericError: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged; please try again.

summary.heading: Order summary
summary.then: Then {price} every month from {date}, until you cancel.
summary.cancel: Cancel any time from your account. Your plan stays on until the end of the month you paid for.

manager.pastDue: The last renewal payment did not go through. Stripe will try again over the next days; your access continues meanwhile. Update your card to pay now.
manager.cancelConfirm: Cancel this plan? It stays on until {date} and is not charged again.
manager.changeFailed: That could not be changed just now. Please try again.
manager.cancelled: Your plan will end on {date}. You can undo this until then.
manager.resumed: Your plan will renew as usual.

card.saved: Your new card is saved and will be used for every plan.
card.savedAndRetried: Your new card is saved and will be used for every plan. We charged the new card for the renewal that had failed.
card.failed: The card could not be saved. Your previous card is unchanged.
card.network: We could not reach the server. Your previous card is unchanged.
